even_order.log_kappa_coefficient_status: EXACT. The resonances cancel: residues C_1(s1=1,s2=3) = +1/16, C_1(s1=3,s2=1) = -1/16 (equal weight A_0 A_1, arguments swapped) and C_3(s1=3,s2=3) = 0, so r = 0 and the coefficient is -2r = 0. The residues are nu-INDEPENDENT (+1/16, -1/16, 0), so r = 0 is structural, not an accident of nu_L.
even_order.finite_part_status: DERIVED (batch 67). Codex s second-endpoint formula via the trace recurrence [H,B_s] = s{H,A_s} - 2(s+1)A_(s+2) + (s^3/2 - 2 s nu^2)A_s, which eliminates every shifted double moment in favour of the single K(q,q) = N(q,q). At the anchor (q=1, n=-2, v_1=1/6) the double-moment coefficient a + nR(1) = nu^2 - 1/12 VANISHES at nu_L = 1/sqrt(12), where a = q^2 v_1 and R(q) = q(q^2/4 - nu^2)/(q+1); K(q,q) is the only carrier of the trigamma/5F4 structure, so it drops and the remaining four terms are elementary, summing symbolically to C = -nu_L/144 = -sqrt(3)/864. Opus 5 s resonant finite-part machinery CONFIRMS: non-resonant agreement 7.0e-12 (inside that route s own 5.9e-10 spread), closed-form match 4.3e-19, M1-independence to 19 digits, four fibres (t = 2.99, 2.999, 2.9999, 2.99999) and two momenta whose deviations fall linearly in h to the same limit (momentum-freedom). ATTRIBUTION: the derivation is Codex s; the resonant machinery, the value and the numerical support are Opus 5 s; the vanishing-coefficient observation is Codex s via Fable. Supersedes the earlier status recognition-not-derivation.

h_series._note: C_(2q)(3+h) through h^4, coefficients of 1, e_1, delta, delta^2 (no other monomial occurs).  STRUCTURE: only v_1 and v_2 carry momentum, C = S_0 + S_1 v_1 + S_2 v_1^2 + S_v v_2 with four momentum-free scalars (alpha, beta, gamma, delta_f in batch 68).  In the second-endpoint form (38(bs) item 5) the momentum enters through a = q^2 v_1 and v_2 only, and the double moment K(q,q) only through (a + nR(q))^2, which gives three EXACT ALL-t statements (see all_t).  DERIVED ABSENCES: delta is absent at h^1 and h^2 because [delta]C = -(t^2-9)/(2(t^2-1)) [delta^2]C with the ratio O(h) and [delta^2]C = O(h^2); at the anchor the h^1 absence is the scalar identity 6 S_1 + 2 S_2 - 9 S_v = (1 - 12 nu^2) K(1,1) [at q = 1 the trace recurrence gives S_1 = 2T(1,3) = (1/2 - 2 nu^2) K(1,1) - 3nu/4, S_2 = -K(1,1), S_v = J(2) = -nu/2], which vanishes at nu_L^2 = 1/12 -- the SAME vanishing as a + nR(1) = nu^2 - 1/12 that makes -sqrt(3)/864 elementary.  (Batch 68 called the h^1 absence unpredicted; it is derived.)  L = psi(sqrt 3/6) + log 2 is the only way psi(sqrt 3/6) and log 2 enter; Euler's gamma cancels.  Whether the h^3 onset of delta here and in the odd-order remainder R share a mechanism is NOT asserted.
h_series.method: Exact entries: the second-endpoint formula expanded in h by truncated power series with exact coefficients (polygamma values at sqrt(3)/6 and at integers, K(q,q) kept as K0 + K1 h + ..., K0 = psi_1(1/2 + sqrt(3)/6)/8), every expression then reduced over Q(sqrt 3) and re-evaluated against the unreduced form to 1e-50 at write time.  Independent check, asserted at write time: the four momentum-free scalars by the FOUR-N route (Hurwitz continuation) at 15 fibres h = -k/750, k = 1..15, 80 digits, cutoff plateau 3e-66, momentum coefficients assembled exactly, Taylor coefficients by degree-14 interpolation with the degree-13 least-squares spread as the error; every exact entry agrees with it inside that spread (observed 6e-34 at h^0 to 4e-22 at h^4).  Numerical entries (h^3 delta^2, h^4 delta, h^4 delta^2) take the extraction's value; the batch-68 fit values are kept alongside.  Seal: PREDICTION_batch69_closed_forms.txt sha256 57c3b5c4...
